q.en: How do I request an appointment?

a.id: Hubungi admin dan sebutkan hari serta kebutuhan kunjungan. Tunggu konfirmasi jadwal.
a.en: Contact the clinic with your preferred day and visit purpose, then wait for confirmation.

a.id: Konfirmasikan jadwal dokter sebelum datang; jam fasilitas dapat berbeda dari jam praktik.
a.en: Confirm the dentist’s schedule before visiting; facility hours may differ.

a.en: Fees have not been verified. Ask for an estimate and terms after an examination.

a.id: Konfirmasikan asuransi, syarat rujukan, dan dokumen kepada admin.
a.en: Check insurance arrangements, referral requirements and documents with the clinic.

a.id: Jelaskan kebutuhan Anda kepada admin. Jenis tindakan ditentukan setelah pemeriksaan dokter.
a.en: Describe your needs to the clinic. Treatment is determined after a dental examination.
